india_trends.title: Airtel Payments Bank IPO in pipeline? Bharti Airtel payments business eyes D-Street debut, says report

india_trends.title: Upcoming IPO: Razorpay gets SEBI nod for IPO launch: Top things to know about the issue
india_trends.summary: SEBI has approved Razorpay’s IPO proposal, five months after the fintech confidentially filed draft documents. The company reportedly plans to raise $600 million, as it broadens beyond online payments into payroll, merchant lending and emerging AI-led commerce.
